1.consolidated_definition: Ave acuática de hasta 25 cm de longitud, de plumaje gris oscuro, ojos amarillos, pico agudo y corto, negro con la punta gris, y patas negras. Podicipedidae, Tachybaptus dominicus.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Waterbird measuring up to 25 cm in length, with dark grey plumage, yellow eyes, a sharp and short black beak with a grey tip, and black legs. Family Podicipedidae, Tachybaptus dominicus.
